description: Some exploratory web searches from before capture was active are not logged. The current captured set includes monthly/weekly searches, a cross-month Dzongkha query, targeted December coverage and BBS/Kuensel searches; prior query text and counts are not reconstructed.
required_followup: Use current captured logs as the audit record; log further actual queries at execution.

description: Dzongkha and Nepali queries returned mostly unrelated or regional results. Local-language news and local community reporting by dzongkhag were not comprehensively reviewed; researcher fluency is limited.
required_followup: Have a capable local-language researcher review district and community sources if extending coverage.

description: Searches included national and regional press, land, labor, rights/GBV, and date windows, but did not systematically query every dzongkhag, workplace or community. Kuensel date-targeted queries returned unrelated/stale material.
required_followup: Perform dated district-level and sector-specific follow-up if a fuller sweep is required.

description: The Damphu reporting was followed across October, November and December; articles describe private weekly religious meetings and legal proceedings, not a qualifying protest. No separate Q4 protest episode surfaced that could be continuity-checked across neighboring months.
required_followup: If independent evidence of a public protest or a specific >=50 gathering emerges, reassess onset, ownership, attendance and continuity before creating any candidate.

description: Only open-web research was possible; LexisNexis/equivalent local newspaper archive was unavailable. This is a method limitation, not proof that no protests occurred.
required_followup: No bypass attempted; any later archive review must be recorded separately.
